title: The Third Letter
author: Coral Dravenmoor
blurb: Odile Almeida, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
